advancedImportNotFoundAction.error: Report the row as an error
advancedImportNotFoundAction.skip: Import the row without the relation

advancedImportMultipleAction.error: Report the row as an error

tooltips.advancedImportNotFoundAction: Applies when a column is mapped to a foreign field, e.g. Department (Code), and no related record has that value. Rows with an empty value are always imported without the relation.
tooltips.advancedImportMultipleAction: Applies when more than one related record has the value from the file. Matching is reliable only when the value is unique, such as a code or an external ID.
